test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. The group of scientists was looking for a new planet outside of our solar system, known as an exoplanet.

Q. They observed the far-off star using a powerful telescope in search of a telltale dimming of its brightness.

R. They found a new planet, establishing its existence through a series of follow-up observations.

S. This slight dimming would indicate a planet passing in front of the star.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentences need to be arranged in a logical and coherent sequence to form a meaningful paragraph.
 
• **Sentence P is the first sentence** as it introduces the central idea about the group of scientists looking for a new exoplanet:
 
 
• "The group of scientists was looking for a new planet outside of our solar system, known as an exoplanet."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q follows** as it explains the method the scientists used to search for the exoplanet:
 
 
• "They observed the far-off star using a powerful telescope in search of a telltale dimming of its brightness."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S is the third sentence** as it elaborates on the significance of the dimming of the star's brightness:
 
 
• "This slight dimming would indicate a planet passing in front of the star."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R is the fourth** as it concludes the paragraph by stating the discovery of the new planet:
 
 
• "They found a new planet, establishing its existence through a series of follow-up observations."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **P, Q, S, R**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The group of scientists was looking for a new planet outside of our solar system, known as an exoplanet. They observed the far-off star using a powerful telescope in search of a telltale dimming of its brightness. This slight dimming would indicate a planet passing in front of the star. They found a new planet, establishing its existence through a series of follow-up observations."</div
